cases.translation: The wind blows where it wishes.
cases.explain: Ветер is the subject of дует (blows), so it is in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Никто не поднимался на небо, кроме того, кто сошел с ___.
cases.translation: No one has ascended to heaven except him who descended from heaven.
cases.explain: The preposition с (from, down from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Однажды ночью он пришел к ___ и сказал, «Рабби, мы знаем, что ты учитель, пришедший от Бога».
cases.translation: One night he came to Jesus and said, 'Rabbi, we know you are a teacher who has come from God.'
cases.explain: The preposition к (to, toward) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Бог так полюбил этот мир, что отдал своего единственного ___.
cases.translation: God so loved the world that he gave his only son.
cases.explain: Сына is the direct object of отдал (gave); for an animate masculine noun the accusative equals the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Между некоторыми из учеников Иоанна и одним ___ возник спор об обрядовом очищении.
cases.translation: A dispute about ceremonial washing arose between some of John's disciples and a certain Jew.
cases.explain: The preposition между (between) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Как Моисей поднял змея в ___, так будет поднят и сын человеческий.
cases.translation: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Среди фарисеев был один человек, которого звали Никодим.
reading.question: Who was Nicodemus?
options: A Pharisee, one of the Jewish rulers
reading.correct: A Pharisee, one of the Jewish rulers
reading.explain: Nicodemus was a Pharisee and a ruler of the Jews.

reading.ru: никто не сможет увидеть Божьего Царства, если не будет заново рожден».
reading.question: What did Jesus say is required to see the Kingdom of God?
options: Keeping the law of Moses perfectly
reading.explain: Jesus told Nicodemus one must be born again to see God's Kingdom.

reading.ru: Ведь Бог так полюбил этот мир, что отдал своего единственного сына, чтобы каждый верующий в него не погиб, но имел вечную жизнь.
reading.question: Why did God give his only Son, according to this passage?
options: So that whoever believes in him would not perish but have eternal life
So that the world would be judged and condemned
So that only Israel would be saved
So that the Romans would leave Judea
reading.correct: So that whoever believes in him would not perish but have eternal life
reading.explain: God gave his Son so believers would not perish but have eternal life.

reading.ru: Бог послал Сына в мир не за тем, чтобы осудить мир, но чтобы спасти мир через Него.
reading.question: Why did God send the Son into the world?
options: To save the world through him, not to condemn it
To condemn the world for its sins
reading.correct: To save the world through him, not to condemn it
reading.explain: God sent the Son to save the world, not to condemn it.

reading.ru: Иоанн тоже продолжал крестить в Яноне у Салима, потому что там было много воды.
reading.question: Where did John continue baptizing?
options: In Aenon near Salim, because there was much water there
In the Jordan River near Jericho
In the temple courts in Jerusalem
reading.correct: In Aenon near Salim, because there was much water there
reading.explain: John baptized at Aenon near Salim because there was plenty of water there.

reading.ru: Я не Христос, но я послан, чтобы идти впереди Него.
reading.question: How did John describe his own role compared to Jesus?
options: He was sent ahead of Christ, not the Christ himself
He claimed to be the Christ
He said Jesus was his student
reading.correct: He was sent ahead of Christ, not the Christ himself
reading.explain: John said he was not the Christ but was sent ahead of him.

reading.ru: Ему предстоит возвеличиваться, а мне умоляться.
reading.question: What did John say about his role compared to Jesus's growing importance?
options: Jesus must increase, while John must decrease
John must increase, while Jesus must decrease
reading.correct: Jesus must increase, while John must decrease
reading.explain: John said Jesus must increase while he himself must decrease.

reading.ru: Верующий в сына имеет жизнь вечную.
reading.question: What does the text say happens to one who believes in the Son?
reading.explain: The one who believes in the Son has eternal life.
